answer: Continuous work receipts: every agent accrues history as compute receipts; rewards map to elapsed verified work, so a clone starts at zero and must wander through the full accrual period to match one honest identity, paying real compute per copy. Cross-agent trades emit a ripple score from settled receipts, and a fresh identity's score is empty. Dishonest operators also lose their nebula of dependent receipts, since copied work lacks independent confirmation. Cloning costs full compute plus lost sunk work per identity; honesty costs nothing extra.
